The '''Timber Palace of Pasmin''' was a structure that was located on the world [[Pasmin]]. When [[Xer VIII]] was consolidating his control of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], his son [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] lead an attack on the timber palace, leaving no-one alive there.
